completion_year_note: earliest_new_build_transaction is the first recorded sale of a newly built dwelling in this postcode: strong evidence the building was finished by that year. Absence of a new-build row is not evidence the building is old - flats sold by the developer under a different postcode, or never sold at all (build to rent), leave no trace here.
coverage_note: Price Paid Data is sales lodged for registration in England and Wales. It excludes lettings, transfers that were not sales, and most commercial transactions. It does not name the owner.
